cities.name: Rome
cities.description: Imperial capital. Unvisited church; later the setting of house arrest and a final imprisonment.

cities.name: Corinth
cities.description: Achaian port Paul planted on the second journey. Origin of Romans; destination of 1–2 Corinthians.

cities.name: Ephesus
cities.description: Asian capital of Paul’s longest stay. Origin of 1 Corinthians; Timothy’s station in the Pastorals.

cities.name: Philippi
cities.description: First European plant. Partner in giving; destination of Philippians.

cities.name: Thessalonica
cities.description: Macedonian port church planted in weeks, then left under pressure.

cities.name: Colossae
cities.description: Lycus-valley town. Church founded by Epaphras; home of Philemon.

cities.name: Galatia
cities.description: Default pin is south Galatia (Iconium / Lystra / Derbe region). North Galatia remains a live option.

cities.name: Antioch (Syria)
cities.description: Sending church of the journeys. Default origin of Galatians on the early south-Galatia dating.

cities.name: Jerusalem
cities.description: Mother church and council. No surviving Pauline letter is addressed here; the collection is aimed here.

cities.name: The road to Damascus
cities.description: Acts 9. The origin of Paul’s road: the risen Lord meets him on the way to Damascus.

cities.name: Damascus
cities.description: Where Paul is led after the vision, baptized, and first preaches Jesus (Acts 9).

cities.name: Caesarea
cities.description: Two-year custody after Acts 21. A proposed prison origin; no letter is securely placed here.

cities.name: Macedonia
cities.description: Region of Philippi, Thessalonica, and Berea. Origin of 2 Corinthians and, traditionally, 1 Timothy and Titus.

cities.name: Crete
cities.description: Island where Titus is left to appoint elders in every town.

cities.name: Nicopolis
cities.description: Actian city on the Adriatic. Paul tells Titus he will winter here (Titus 3:12).

cities.name: Athens
cities.description: Second-journey stop before Corinth.

cities.name: Troas
cities.description: Aegean crossing point toward Macedonia.

cities.name: Paphos
cities.description: First-journey landfall with Barnabas.

cities.name: Salamis
cities.description: Eastern Cyprus, first-journey landing.

cities.name: Tarsus
cities.description: Paul’s home city, on the road north from Antioch.

cities.name: Lystra
cities.description: South-Galatian town; Timothy’s home.

cities.name: Derbe
cities.description: Eastern turn of the first journey — as far as Paul goes in south Galatia (Acts 14:20–21).

cities.name: Iconium
cities.description: South-Galatian city on the first and second journeys.

cities.name: Pisidian Antioch
cities.description: First-journey synagogue sermon; south-Galatian plant.

cities.name: Perga
cities.description: Pamphylian city south of Galatia. First-journey landing after Cyprus (Acts 13:13).

cities.name: Miletus
cities.description: Third-journey farewell to the Ephesian elders.

cities.name: Malta
cities.description: Shipwreck landfall on the way to Rome.

cities.name: Puteoli
cities.description: Italian landfall before the walk to Rome.

cities.name: Berea
cities.description: Second-journey church after Thessalonica.

cities.name: Sidon
cities.description: Coastal call on the voyage to Rome.

cities.name: Myra
cities.description: Lycian transfer toward the Alexandrian grain ship.

cities.name: Fair Havens
cities.description: Cretan anchorage before the storm.

cities.name: Syracuse
cities.description: Sicilian stop after Malta.

cities.name: Rhegium
cities.description: Toe of Italy on the last sea leg.

cities.name: Tyre
cities.description: Third-journey landing on the way to Jerusalem.

cities.name: Cenchreae
cities.description: Eastern port of Corinth. Phoebe’s church.
